what_the_paper_currently_claims.body.tex_209-229 (scout cited 207-224; f: The transformer's toy number (6.57 dB) is 'not a measurement of the transformer': its objective sat flat at ~1.0 (0.9912 final, 0.9880 last-ten mean), 'the project's record attributes that to the zero-initialised residual gates the transformer's normalisation layers use at initialisation'. The paper reports that reading 'as the project's, not as ours, because the experiment that would establish it was never run', and states the three-way comparison 'does not exist on disk. What exists is one run, at one seed, whose objective did not move.'
what_the_paper_currently_claims.body.tex_596-601 (scout cited 577-582): 'No claim is made that the initialisation scheme caused that stall. The reading is the project's own ... but the ablation that would isolate it ... is specified in the project's design and has not been executed. This paper reports the specification's absence rather than substituting for it.'
what_the_paper_currently_claims.review-checklist.md_133-151: gate INIT_ABLATION_NOT_RUN_REVIEW signed on the proposition 'the paper truthfully states the ablation was not run'.
what_the_paper_currently_claims.testable_content: The attribution is to zero-initialised AdaLN gates. init_ablation.py's docstring records that the Diffusers 'ada_norm_zero' default (library_default) does NOT zero those weights; dit_zero does. So the attribution predicts: library_default stalls only if something other than exact zeroing is responsible; dit_zero is the arm that actually carries zero gates. Whatever pattern appears, the paragraphs above become false the moment run/ exists and must be rewritten (not by this run).

per_cell_primary.mean_last10_loss: train.mean_last10_loss from common.summarize_losses (mean of the last 10 of 50 step losses)
per_cell_primary.restored_psnr_mean: eval.restored_psnr_mean on the frozen 10 test pairs, RGB-full, 30 DDPM steps (common.sample_and_eval:v1)
per_cell_primary.degraded_input_psnr_mean: eval.degraded_input_psnr_mean (identity/do-nothing reference on the same pairs; bound value 20.75 dB)

stall_indicator.definition: A cell STALLS iff train.mean_last10_loss >= 0.90. Rationale: the epsilon-prediction MSE against unit-variance noise is ~1.0 when the network contributes nothing (body.tex:212-214); the bound stalled run has last-ten mean 0.9880; the bound 50-step U-Net reached 0.081. A 10 per cent departure from unity in the last ten steps is the minimum that can be called 'left its initialisation'.
stall_indicator.tie_breaker: none; the threshold is a hard inequality on the recorded float
stall_indicator.mode_level: A MODE STALLS iff >= 2 of its 3 seeds stall. A MODE ESCAPES iff <= 1 of its 3 seeds stall.
stall_indicator.descriptive_only: restored_psnr_mean vs degraded_input_psnr_mean (identity crossing) and vs the bound 6.57 dB are reported per cell but do not enter the rule; analyze_init_ablation.py kill_rules.decision is recorded verbatim as a second, independent reading.

endpoints.reproduction_check_descriptive: library_default seed 0 is the same construction, seed, steps, batch and learning rate as the bound toy record. Report |mean_last10_loss - 0.9880| and |restored_psnr_mean - 6.57|. This is descriptive: GPU nondeterminism and DataLoader worker count can move it; it does not gate any rule.

reading_rules.evaluation_order: Rules are evaluated in the order R3, R2, R1, R4; the first that matches fires. R3 and R2 are mutually exclusive with each other and with R1.

R1_INIT_DEPENDENT.condition: library_default MODE STALLS (>= 2/3 seeds) AND at least one of {dit_standard, dit_zero} MODE ESCAPES (<= 1/3 seeds stall)
R1_INIT_DEPENDENT.sentence: The stall reproduces under the library default initialisation and disappears under <named mode(s)>, so on this toy the stall is initialisation-dependent. Which named mode escapes is reported; if dit_zero escapes while library_default stalls, the specific 'zero-initialised gates' attribution is contradicted even though initialisation-dependence holds, and the rewrite must say so.
R1_INIT_DEPENDENT.tex_consequence: body.tex:220-229 rewritten to report the 9-cell result; body.tex:596-601 rewritten to drop 'has not been executed'.

R2_NOT_ISOLATED_AT_BUDGET.sentence: All three initialisations stall at 50 steps; initialisation alone is not isolated at this budget. No longer-budget cell is added in this round.
R2_NOT_ISOLATED_AT_BUDGET.tex_consequence: same two paragraphs rewritten; the attribution to initialisation is reported as not supported at this budget, not as refuted.

R3_STALL_NOT_REPRODUCED.condition: 0 of 9 cells stall (including all three library_default seeds)
R3_STALL_NOT_REPRODUCED.sentence: The bound single-seed stall does not reproduce in three seeds of the same construction; the toy reproduction sentences (body.tex:209-218, and every use of ToyTransLoss/ToyTransLastTen as evidence of a stall) must be re-scoped to 'one recorded run at one seed that did not reproduce'.
R3_STALL_NOT_REPRODUCED.tex_consequence: larger rewrite than R1/R2; the crop128 thesis is untouched.

R4_MIXED.condition: anything else (e.g. library_default escapes while an alternative stalls; library_default splits 1/3 or 2/3 with all alternatives also splitting; stall present in some but not all seeds without a mode-level pattern)
R4_MIXED.sentence: The stall is seed- and initialisation-sensitive in a pattern that does not support a one-sentence attribution; the paragraphs report the per-cell table and state that the ablation was run and did not isolate a single cause.
R4_MIXED.tex_consequence: both paragraphs rewritten; no attribution sentence in either direction.
